meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: Claude 会为 HyperFrames 合成编写可安全跳转的关键帧动画:推近拉远、缩放、平移、Ken Burns 相机移动、遮罩裁切与 3D 深度等,并用 hyperframes keyframes 等命令逐帧校验画面。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推近/拉远、缩放、相机移动等关键帧时接管;不用于整体场景策划、品牌设计、字幕等非关键帧工作。

say.text: 给这个镜头加一个从 1.0 到 1.3 的推近关键帧,最后保持住
say.note: 在 clip 内的包装层上做 scale 关键帧

say.text: 做一段 Ken Burns 缓移:主体平移到画面中央并轻微放大
say.note: 用包装层平移加缩放实现

say.text: 用 hyperframes keyframes 检查一下这段动画的关键帧
say.note: 会跑关键帧诊断并给出证据

howto.what_en: Claude authors seek-safe keyframes for HyperFrames compositions — punch-ins, zooms, pans, Ken Burns camera moves, masks and 3D depth — then verifies them with hyperframes keyframes diagnostics.
howto.when_en: Used when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-in/out, zoom, reframe or camera keyframes; not for scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing or captions.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in keyframe from 1.0 to 1.3 scale on this shot, then hold
say_en.note: keyframes scale on a wrapper inside the clip

say_en.text: Give me a Ken Burns move: pan the subject to center and scale up slightly
Run hyperframes keyframes to check this animation's keyframes
